description: Trap (audit finding: s.234B charged on the full shortfall up to the filing date although self-assessment tax was paid earlier; s.234B(2) of the 1961 Act / s.424(4) of the 2025 Act). Salary 24,00,000 (employer TDS 1,44,100) + FD interest 5,00,000 (TDS 50,000). New regime: 24,00,000 - 75,000 = 23,25,000 + 5,00,000 = GTI = TI 28,25,000; tax 20,000 + 40,000 + 60,000 + 80,000 + 1,00,000 (to 24L) + 4,25,000 x 30% 1,27,500 = 4,27,500; no 87A (TI > 12L), no surcharge; cess 17,100; 4,44,600. TDS 1,94,100 (= 26AS) -> assessed tax 2,50,500. Payments: advance tax 10,000 on 15-06-2025 only; self-assessment tax 1,92,400 on 25-04-2026 and 48,100 on 25-07-2026 (2,50,500 in all); return 28-07-2026 (due date 31-07-2026: no 234A, no 234F). 234C: Jun 15% 37,575 - 10,000 (< 12% relief 30,060) = 27,575 -> 27,500 x 1% x 3 = 825; Sep 45% 1,12,725 - 10,000 = 1,02,725 -> 1,02,700 x 3% = 3,081; Dec 75% 1,87,875 - 10,000 = 1,77,875 -> 1,77,800 x 3% = 5,334; Mar 2,50,500 - 10,000 = 2,40,500 x 1% = 2,405; total 11,645. 234B: advance tax by 31 March 10,000 < 90% of 2,50,500 (2,25,450) -> applies on 2,40,500. s.234B(2) staging: April (the 25-04 payment falls in April, a part of a month of the period up to that payment) on 2,40,500 = 2,405; May, June, July on 2,40,500 - 1,92,400 = 48,100 x 1% x 3 = 1,443 (the 25-07 payment reduces nothing: July carries the shortfall outstanding at its start and the return is filed in July); total 3,848. The old code charged 2,40,500 x 1% x 4 months (Apr-Jul) = 9,620. Net payable 4,44,600 + 3,848 + 11,645 - 1,94,100 - 2,50,500 = 15,493 -> s.288B 15,490 (old code 4,44,600 + 9,620 + 11,645 - 1,94,100 - 2,50,500 = 21,265 -> 21,270). Warn tax.advance-tax-interest only. Old regime (comparison, not chosen): 24,00,000 - 50,000 - 2,400 + 5,00,000 = 28,47,600: 12,500 + 1,00,000 + 18,47,600 x 30% 5,54,280 = 6,66,780; cess 26,671.20; 6,93,451. ITR-1.
